title: Core Linear Algebra & Matrix Methods
brief: SVD, QR, Cholesky, eigensolvers, sparse matrices, tensor algebra — the foundation every downstream engine needs for PCA, FEM, optimization, and system identification.

units.title: SVDEngine — Singular Value Decomposition
units.description: Golub-Kahan bidiagonalization for U*Sigma*V^T; truncated SVD for dimensionality reduction; condition number estimation; pseudo-inverse via SVD; rank determination with tolerance. Used by: PCA, least-squares, low-rank approximation.
exit_conditions: Full SVD for arbitrary m×n matrices

units.title: QRDecompositionEngine — QR Factorization
units.description: Householder reflectors + Givens rotations; column-pivoted rank-revealing QR; thin QR for overdetermined systems; application to least-squares fitting of Taylor tool life curves and Kienzle coefficient regression.

units.title: CholeskyEngine — Cholesky Factorization
units.description: LL^T for symmetric positive-definite matrices; incomplete Cholesky for preconditioning; LDLT for semi-definite; validates positive-definiteness before factoring. Used by Bayesian posterior covariance, Kalman filter, FEM stiffness.

units.title: EigensolverEngine — Eigenvalue/Eigenvector Computation
units.description: Power iteration (dominant), inverse iteration (target), QR algorithm (full spectrum), Lanczos (symmetric sparse for FEM modal analysis); shift-and-invert for interior eigenvalues; generalized eigenvalue (A*x = lambda*B*x for FEM).

units.title: MatrixFactorizationEngine — NMF, Sparse Storage, Matrix Exponential
units.description: Non-negative Matrix Factorization for process fingerprinting; sparse matrix storage (CSR/CSC) for FEM; matrix exponential (Pade approximation) for continuous-time Markov; Kronecker product for multi-dimensional FEM assembly.

units.title: IterativeSolverEngine — CG, BiCGSTAB, GMRES
units.description: Conjugate Gradient for SPD systems; BiCGSTAB for non-symmetric; GMRES with restart; preconditioners (Jacobi, ILU(0), SSOR); convergence monitoring with residual tracking.

units.title: SparseMatrixEngine — CSR/CSC/COO with Fill-Reducing Ordering
units.description: CSR/CSC/COO sparse formats; sparse BLAS (SpMV, SpMM); fill-reducing ordering (Cuthill-McKee, AMD); sparse Cholesky; triplet assembly for FEM global stiffness.

units.title: MatrixNormEngine — Frobenius, Spectral, Condition Number
units.description: Frobenius, spectral (2-norm), infinity, 1-norm; condition number estimation without full SVD; matrix logarithm for rotation interpolation; matrix square root for covariance decomposition.

units.title: TensorAlgebraEngine — Stress/Strain Tensors for Solid Mechanics
units.description: Rank-2 and rank-4 tensor operations; Voigt notation (6×6 ↔ 3×3×3×3); tensor rotation (Q*T*Q^T); stress/strain invariants (I1, I2, I3, J2); deviatoric/hydrostatic decomposition; elastic stiffness tensor (C_ijkl).
exit_conditions: Stress invariants (I1, I2, I3, J2, von Mises)

units.title: SystemIdentificationEngine — Subspace ID from Sensor Data
units.description: Least-squares system ID; recursive least squares (RLS) for online parameter estimation; total least squares for errors-in-variables; N4SID subspace identification for MIMO cutting dynamics.

units.title: RobustRegressionEngine — Ridge, Lasso, RANSAC
units.description: Ridge (L2), Lasso (L1), Elastic Net for regularized cutting coefficient fitting; Huber regression for outlier-robust force calibration; RANSAC for geometric fitting from CMM data.
exit_conditions: Comparison with OLS on noisy data

units.title: RandomMatrixEngine — Noise Floor Estimation
units.description: Marchenko-Pastur distribution for noise floor in sensor covariance; Tracy-Widom for signal detection (significant eigenvalues); spiked covariance for process signal separation.

units.title: LinearAlgebraDispatcherActions — Wire to calcDispatcher
units.description: Wire SVD, QR, Cholesky, Eigen, Sparse solve, Tensor ops into calcDispatcher: svd_decompose, qr_factorize, cholesky_factor, eigen_solve, sparse_solve, tensor_stress_invariants, system_identify, robust_regression.

units.title: LinearAlgebraTestSuite — 40+ Exhaustive Tests
units.description: Known decompositions for Hilbert matrices, random SPD, rank-deficient, singular (graceful failure), ill-conditioned (warning), sparse CG convergence, tensor rotations.

units.title: Upgrade PCA → SVD-backed with Kernel/Incremental PCA
units.description: Upgrade PrincipalComponentEngine to use SVDEngine; add kernel PCA (RBF for nonlinear process monitoring); incremental PCA for streaming sensor data; robust PCA via nuclear norm.

units.title: Upgrade FEM → Sparse Solver Backend
units.description: Upgrade FiniteElementEngine to use SparseMatrixEngine and IterativeSolverEngine; add 2D quad4 elements; connect EigensolverEngine for modal analysis.

units.title: FormulaRegistryUpdate — Register Linear Algebra Methods
units.description: Register SVD, QR, Cholesky, eigenvalue formulas; add AlgorithmRegistry entries; update constants.ts with numerical tolerances (EPS_SVD, EPS_CHOLESKY).

forge_triple.hook: enforce-linalg-canonical — blocks ad-hoc matrix decomposition; forces import from SVD/QR/Cholesky engines

safety_gates: All decompositions must handle singular/ill-conditioned matrices gracefully (throw descriptive error, never NaN)
Sparse solver convergence must be monitored; fail after max iterations with partial result
